content.text:
I added the manufacturer-or-trader question to the questionnaire. Vendors must now say, for each line they quote, whether they are the manufacturer or a trader/distributor, and name the manufacturing site (city and country). I also widened the manufacturer-documents term to cover distributors as well as traders.

I checked the vendor list and line data again, and they match the draft. V02 (Tungabhadra) is a distributor, V04 (Lumen Peptide, Singapore) is a trader, and V05 (Nilagiri Phytolabs) is a manufacturer.

Should I add a question asking each vendor to name its batch-release or QC lab for the three new peptide and rosemary lines?
